title.en: I am, you are, she is

goal.sl: Poveš, kdo je kdo, kje je kdo in kako se počuti (I'm, you're, she's, we're, they're), poveš, česa ni (isn't, aren't), in vprašaš (Are you …? Is she …?) s kratkimi odgovori.
goal.de: Du sagst, wer jemand ist, wo jemand ist und wie es jemandem geht (I'm, you're, she's, we're, they're), was nicht so ist (isn't, aren't), und fragst (Are you …? Is she …?) mit kurzen Antworten.
goal.it: Dici chi è qualcuno, dov'è e come sta (I'm, you're, she's, we're, they're), dici cosa non è così (isn't, aren't) e chiedi (Are you …? Is she …?) con le risposte brevi.
goal.en: You can say who and where people are and how they feel (I'm, you're, she's, we're, they're), say what isn't so (isn't, aren't) and ask (Are you …? Is she …?) with short answers.

say.sl: **to be** (biti) ima tri oblike: **I am** (jaz sem), **you are** (ti si, vi ste) ter **he is**, **she is**, **it is** (on, ona, ono je) za eno drugo osebo ali stvar. **Mrs Birkett is at the inn.** (Gospa Birkett je v gostilni.) **Meg is on the fell.** (Meg je na hribu.) Osebek je vedno zraven, tudi it: **It is cold.** (Mrzlo je.)
say.de: **to be** (sein) hat drei Formen: **I am** (ich bin), **you are** (du bist, Sie sind) und **he is**, **she is**, **it is** (er, sie, es ist) für eine andere Person oder Sache. **Mrs Birkett is at the inn.** (Mrs Birkett ist im Gasthaus.) **Meg is on the fell.** (Meg ist am Berg.) Das Subjekt steht immer, auch it: **It is cold.** (Es ist kalt.)
say.it: **to be** (essere) ha tre forme: **I am** (io sono), **you are** (tu sei, Lei è) e **he is**, **she is**, **it is** (lui, lei è) per un'altra persona o cosa. **Mrs Birkett is at the inn.** (Mrs Birkett è alla locanda.) **Meg is on the fell.** (Meg è sul monte.) Il soggetto c'è sempre, anche it: **It is cold.** (Fa freddo.)
say.en: **to be** has three forms: **I am**, **you are**, and **he is**, **she is**, **it is** for one other person or thing. **Mrs Birkett is at the inn.** **Meg is on the fell.** The subject is always there, even it: **It is cold.**

examples.en: Mrs Birkett is at the inn.

say.sl: Za več oseb: **we are** (mi smo), **you are** (vi ste: ista beseda kot za enega), **they are** (oni so). Dva z **and** (in) sta they, dvojine ni: **Jack and Sam are at the inn.** (Jack in Sam sta v gostilni.) Tudi stvari: **The sheep are on the fell.** (Ovce so na hribu.)
say.de: Für mehrere: **we are** (wir sind), **you are** (ihr seid: dasselbe Wort wie für einen), **they are** (sie sind). Zwei mit **and** (und) sind they: **Jack and Sam are at the inn.** (Jack und Sam sind im Gasthaus.) Auch Dinge: **The sheep are on the fell.** (Die Schafe sind am Berg.)
say.it: Per più persone: **we are** (noi siamo), **you are** (voi siete: la stessa parola che per uno), **they are** (loro sono). Due persone con **and** (e) sono they: **Jack and Sam are at the inn.** (Jack e Sam sono alla locanda.) Anche le cose: **The sheep are on the fell.** (Le pecore sono sul monte.)
say.en: For more than one: **we are**, **you are** (the same word for many), **they are**. Two people with **and** are they: **Jack and Sam are at the inn.** Things too: **The sheep are on the fell.**

examples.en: The sheep are on the fell.

say.sl: V govoru so oblike kratke: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**. Opuščaj (') stoji namesto izpuščene črke: I am → **I'm**. Tudi ime dobi **'s**: **Jack's on the fell.** (Jack je na hribu.) Prav je oboje; ljudje govorijo kratko obliko.
say.de: Beim Sprechen sind die Formen kurz: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**. Der Apostroph steht für den weggelassenen Buchstaben: I am → **I'm**. Auch ein Name bekommt **'s**: **Jack's on the fell.** (Jack ist am Berg.) Beides ist richtig; man sagt die kurze Form.
say.it: Quando si parla, le forme sono brevi: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**. L'apostrofo sta per la lettera tolta: I am → **I'm**. Anche un nome prende **'s**: **Jack's on the fell.** (Jack è sul monte.) Sono giuste tutte e due; si dice la forma breve.
say.en: When we speak, the forms are short: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**. The apostrophe stands for the letter left out: I am → **I'm**. A name takes **'s** too: **Jack's on the fell.** Both are right; people say the short form.

say.sl: Za zanikanje daš **not** (ne) za glagol: **I'm not** (nisem), **he isn't** (ni), **we aren't** (nismo). **Jack isn't at home.** (Jacka ni doma.) **The sheep aren't in the field.** (Ovc ni na polju.) **He's not** in **we're not** pomenita isto. Nikoli *I amn't*: samo **I'm not**.
say.de: Zum Verneinen kommt **not** (nicht) nach dem Verb: **I'm not** (ich bin nicht), **he isn't** (er ist nicht), **we aren't** (wir sind nicht). **Jack isn't at home.** (Jack ist nicht zu Hause.) **The sheep aren't in the field.** (Die Schafe sind nicht auf der Weide.) **He's not** und **we're not** heißen dasselbe. Nie *I amn't*: nur **I'm not**.
say.it: Per dire di no metti **not** (non) dopo il verbo: **I'm not** (non sono), **he isn't** (non è), **we aren't** (non siamo). **Jack isn't at home.** (Jack non è a casa.) **The sheep aren't in the field.** (Le pecore non sono nel campo.) **He's not** e **we're not** vogliono dire lo stesso. Mai *I amn't*: solo **I'm not**.
say.en: To say no, put **not** after the verb: **I'm not** (I am not), **he isn't** (he is not), **we aren't** (we are not). **Jack isn't at home.** **The sheep aren't in the field.** **He's not** and **we're not** mean the same. For I it is only **I'm not** (never *I amn't*).

say.sl: Za vprašanje gre glagol na začetek: **Are you ready?** (Ste pripravljeni?) **Is Mrs Birkett busy?** (Je gospa Birkett zaposlena?) Kratki odgovor ponovi glagol: **Yes, I am.** (Ja.) **No, she isn't.** (Ne.) Nikoli *Yes, I'm*. Počutje gre z be: **I'm hungry** (lačen, lačna sem), **I'm cold** (zebe me), **I'm tired** (utrujen, utrujena sem).
say.de: Für die Frage kommt das Verb nach vorn: **Are you ready?** (Bist du bereit?) **Is Mrs Birkett busy?** (Hat Mrs Birkett viel zu tun?) Die Kurzantwort nimmt das Verb wieder: **Yes, I am.** (Ja.) **No, she isn't.** (Nein.) Nie *Yes, I'm*. Wie es dir geht, sagst du mit be: **I'm hungry** (ich habe Hunger), **I'm cold** (mir ist kalt), **I'm tired** (ich bin müde).
say.it: Per chiedere, il verbo va all'inizio: **Are you ready?** (Siete pronti?) **Is Mrs Birkett busy?** (Mrs Birkett è impegnata?) La risposta breve ripete il verbo: **Yes, I am.** (Sì.) **No, she isn't.** (No.) Mai *Yes, I'm*. Come stai si dice con be, dove l'italiano usa avere: **I'm hungry** (ho fame), **I'm cold** (ho freddo), **I'm tired** (sono stanco, stanca).
say.en: To ask, put the verb first: **Are you ready?** **Is Mrs Birkett busy?** The short answer takes the verb again: **Yes, I am.** (never *Yes, I'm.*) **No, she isn't.** How you feel takes be: **I'm hungry**, **I'm cold**, **I'm tired**.

translation.it: È una mattina fredda nella valle. Nonna Maggie è in cucina. Jack e Meg sono sul monte con le pecore. Io sono alla locanda con Sam. — Sei in ritardo, {learner}! Oggi Mrs Birkett è molto impegnata.
translation.en: It is a cold morning in the dale. Granny Maggie is in the kitchen. Jack and Meg are on the fell with the sheep. I am at the inn with Sam. — You are late, {learner}! Mrs Birkett is busy today.
